coordinates.map_m: x = east, y = north, z = metres above the hub's grade (F1 lobby floor = 0; F2 6, F3 12, F4 + roof terraces 18, F5 24, F6 30, tower eaves 36); origin = Century Tower
coordinates.game: X = (x - cx) * 100, Y = z * 100, Z = -(y - cy) * 100 with (cx, cy) = center_m; Y is the ray-cast collision floor (Mario's feet). Objects that hover (stars, coins) add their own offset.
coordinates.floor_m: collision floor measured by ray-casting the built level (1.5 m above the design height, straight down)

note: Anchor points for the Course 5 mission author (docs/game_design.md 7.5), measured on the built collision of levels/bbh. 'actN_' keys use the design act numbers (7.5: 1 All-Nighter, 2 Quiet Hours Hide-and-Seek (co-op), 3 The Ghost of Finals Past, 4 Lights Out, 5 Coffee Run, 6 Re-shelve the Glowing Books); course act order is the mission author's (docs/flow.md 5.1: solo acts first, co-op last; suggested 1 = design 1, 2 = design 3, 3 = design 2). Points with a 'check' key did not measure as designed. No level-script star: every mission spawns its own (spawn_default_star from the controller, star id act - 1). Act-only devices (stair barriers, rolling ladders, Boos, breakers, the cup) are Lua objects: static level geometry cannot be act-masked.
